title: 第1572章 湘灵出手谁更嚣张第1571章 门前刁难嚣张跋扈
slug: 自缚禁地五百年我当散修你哭啥
content_zh:
楚湘灵一走出来，瞬间吸引了所有人的目光。
她虽然笑着说话，可这份笑容之中，却没有半点面对顾修时的温和，反而透着几分诡异的阴寒。
不知为何。
被她盯着，公孙戟竟然有一种她在看死人的错觉。
不过没等公孙戟回话，使团众人却连忙开口：
“贵人不可啊！”
“您身份尊贵，怎可让您以身涉险？”
“是啊是啊，我等就算是死，也绝对不会让圣城丢人！”
楚湘灵的身份没几个人知道，不过他们都认得这个长得漂亮至极的女人一直跟在自家人皇身边的。
自然而然的，将她当作了顾修的妻妾，算是后宫贵人。
如今她走出来，圣城使团众人只感觉害臊。
他们实力不弱，出事的时候一个个却连站出来都不敢，还得人皇妻妾出面，这要是真的如此，那他们今日所有人怕是都得被人戳脊梁骨。
只是对众人的劝阻，楚湘灵却连头都没回。
她只抬起一根纤长白皙的手指，在唇边轻轻竖了一下：“诸位还是安静些好。”
明明只是一句简单的话语，却让原本还在七嘴八舌劝阻的众人齐齐不由自主地噤了声。
紧接着便是骇然。
他们突然发现，这位平日里总爱黏在顾皇身边撒娇的绝色女子，此刻周身散发的气息，竟拥有着完全不弱于公孙戟的八阶半圣的气息！
这……
这位也是半圣？？？
“八阶半圣？你是何人？”

公孙戟同样有些惊讶，甚至已经下意识地握住了刀柄。
他浸淫战场多年，识人无数，眼前这个女人表面笑吟吟的，可那双眸子深处翻涌的东西却让他脊背微微发寒。
更关键的是。
在她的笑容之下，公孙戟竟隐约察觉到一股若有若无的精神力探了过来，像一条柔软的蛇，悄无声息地钻进他寒霜军阵列的缝隙之中。
“本尊啊……”
却见楚湘灵掩唇轻笑，风情万种的看了顾修一眼：“自然是人皇的玩具了。”
玩具？？？
顾修眼角抽了抽，好在楚湘灵已经跳过这个话题：
“本尊是谁不重要，重要的是……将军麾下这两万寒霜军，练得真是不错呢。”
“哼，那是自……”
公孙戟的话刚要出口，却见楚湘灵已经伸出食指，遥遥朝着寒霜军阵列的某个位置虚虚一点，笑得如同发现了什么有趣玩具的孩子：
“东南角那三千人，煞气最重，可中枢位置却有两个人的气息波动与旁人差了半拍，应该是刚补充进来的新兵吧？”
“北君练兵果然严苛，新兵还没来得及完全融入煞阵，就被拉出来充场面了，啧啧。”
content_en:
As soon as Chu Xiangling walked out, he instantly attracted everyone's attention.
Although she spoke with a smile, there was no trace of the gentleness in her smile when she faced Gu Xiu. Instead, there was a bit of strange coldness.
Don't know why.
When she stared at him, Gongsun Ji actually had the illusion that she was looking at a dead person.
However, before Gongsun Ji could reply, everyone in the mission hurriedly spoke:
"No noble man!"
"You have a distinguished status, how can you be put in danger?"
"Yes, yes, even if we die, we will never embarrass the Holy City!"
Not many people know Chu Xiangling's identity, but they all recognize this extremely beautiful woman who has always been with their royal family.
Naturally, he regarded her as Gu Xiu's wife and concubine, a noble person in the harem.
Now that she came out, everyone in the Holy City Mission just felt ashamed.
They are not weak in strength, but when something goes wrong, none of them even dare to stand up, and they have to have the wives and concubines of the Human Emperor come forward. If this is really the case, then all of them will probably have their backs stabbed today.
Chu Xiangling just tried to dissuade everyone, but Chu Xiangling didn't even look back.
She only raised a slender white finger and raised it slightly to her lips: "Everyone, it's best to be quiet."
It was obviously just a simple sentence, but everyone who was still talking about trying to dissuade them couldn't help but silence.
Then came horror.
They suddenly discovered that this stunning woman who usually loved to stick to Gu Huang's side and act coquettishly, the aura exuding from her body at this moment actually had the aura of an eighth-level semi-saint that was not weaker than Gongsun Ji!
This...
Is this also a semi-saint? ? ?
"Eighth-level Half-Saint? Who are you?"
Gongsun Ji was also a little surprised, and even subconsciously grasped the handle of the knife.
He has been immersed in the battlefield for many years and has met countless people. The woman in front of him smiled on the surface, but what was surging deep in her eyes made his spine shiver slightly.
More importantly.
Under her smile, Gongsun Ji could vaguely detect a vague spiritual power coming over, like a soft snake, quietly slipping into the gaps in his Frost Army array.
"My lord..."
But Chu Xiangling covered her lips and smiled softly, and looked at Gu Xiu with a charming look: "Of course he is the Human Emperor's toy."
Toy? ? ?
Gu Xiu's eyes twitched, but fortunately Chu Xiangling had skipped this topic:
"It doesn't matter who I am, what's important is...the 20,000 frost troops under the general's command are really well trained."
"Huh, that's because..."
Just as Gongsun Ji was about to speak, he saw that Chu Xiangling had already stretched out his index finger and pointed it slightly toward a certain position in the Frost Army array, smiling like a child who had discovered some interesting toy:
"The three thousand people in the southeast corner have the heaviest evil spirits, but there are two people in the central position whose aura fluctuations are half a beat different from the others. They should be the new recruits who have just been added, right?"
"Beijun's military training is really strict. Before the new recruits had time to fully integrate into the evil formation, they were pulled out to make a show. Tsk tsk."
